def transform(sequence):
    new_sequence = []
    if not sequence:
        return []
    new_sequence.append(sequence[0])
    for i in range(len(sequence) - 1):
        sum_val = sequence[i] + sequence[i+1]
        new_sequence.append(sum_val)
        new_sequence.append(sequence[i+1])
    return new_sequence

# Initial sequence N=4

sequences = {0: S0}

current_sequence = S0
for t in range(1, 5):
    current_sequence = transform(current_sequence)
    sequences[t] = current_sequence

# Print the sequences for inspection
print("T=0:", sequences[0])
print("T=1:", sequences[1])
print("T=2:", sequences[2])
print("T=3:", sequences[3])
print("T=4:", sequences[4])

N = 0
limit = 1000

for i in range(1, limit + 1):
    # Lower bound for C (c1+c2): C >= T / (i+1)
    # C_min = ceil(T / (i+1))
    C_min = (T + i) // (i + 1) # Integer division trick for ceiling
    
    # Upper bound for C (c1+c2): C <= T / i
    # C_max = floor(T / i)
    C_max = T // i
    
    # Number of solutions for this i is C_max - C_min + 1, if C_max >= C_min
    if C_max >= C_min:
        count_i = C_max - C_min + 1
        N += count_i

print(N)
